newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish barley offer may eventually land in Saudi.
newsitem.headline: Turkish barley offer may eventually land in Saudi.

text.p: The Turkish state grain board (TMO) barley offer could eventually go towards meeting part of Saudi Arabia's recent purchase of about 500,000 tonnes of feed barley, a senior grain official said on Wednesday.
"I think our barley will find its place in Saudi Arabia because they are seeking barley," said the official.

He told Reuters he believed the TMO's offer -- 100,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley -- had a May or June shipment and could be well sought by international trading companies in the tender on April 29.
European traders have said most of the Saudi demand has been met by EU barley and the remainder could come from Canada.
The TMO is selling the barley from its stocks of about 300,000 tonnes. Officials say the rest will be kept for emergencies.
Its previous attempt to sell 150,000 tonnes of feed and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley failed due to unsatisfactory prices.
